messages:
support_tina: FYI ACME customer is seeing intermittent 503s from their Dedicated cluster 'acme-ded-01' since ~2026-04-12T10:02Z UTC. Seen on /v1/generate. Example request IDs: req_72a9c4, req_72a9d0, req_72a9f1. Need repro steps + logs from the cluster: pod logs, node dmesg/journal, nvidia-smi output, and a debug bundle. :mag:

support_tina: Sample 503 response body from customer (copied):
```json
{
  "request_id": "req_72a9d0",
  "status": 503,
  "error": "runtime_error",
  "message": "backend inference failure: internal error"
}
```

devon_ops: Copy. Can you paste one failing pod name and the tenant id so we can target commands? Also ask the customer for a curl repro (exact headers + body) if they have it.

support_tina: Tenant id is `acme-tenant-13`. Failing pod observed: `inference-runtime-0-5f7b9c8d-2xkq7` in namespace `acme-tenant-13`. Node reported in k8s: `gke-pool-ded-08`. Customer provided this curl (sanitized API key):
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://dedicated.redwood.example.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-test","input":"summarize: ...","max_tokens":256}' \
  --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 30
```
They say it fails ~30% of the time with the 503 above.

alex.s: Ok. Steps I'd like from someone with cluster access (short commands you can paste to them):
```bash
# pod logs (last 30m)
kubectl -n acme-tenant-13 logs inference-runtime-0-5f7b9c8d-2xkq7 -c runtime --since=30m > /tmp/acme-pod-runtime.log
# container exit / restart history
kubectl -n acme-tenant-13 get pods inference-runtime-0-5f7b9c8d-2xkq7 -o yaml | egrep -i "restartCount|state:"
# node journal + dmesg (on node gke-pool-ded-08)
sudo journalctl -u kubelet --since "2026-04-12 09:30" --until "2026-04-12 10:30" > /tmp/node-kubelet.log
dmesg -T | tail -n 200 > /tmp/node-dmesg.log
# GPU snapshot
sudo nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,UTILIZATION > /tmp/nvidia-smi-1905000000.txt
```
If any of those show errors, grab the timestamps and attach them.

maria_ryu: Also grep for kernel Xid messages - those often indicate GPU driver/kernel faults that correlate with 503s from the runtime:
```bash
dmesg -T | egrep -i "NVRM: Xid|GPU fault|cupti" || journalctl -k | egrep -i "NVRM: Xid|Xid"
```
Common pattern we've seen: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:01:00): 31` or `Xid 79` -> usually hardware/driver issue or OOM in the driver. If you see that, note exact dmesg lines and times. :eyes:

devon_ops: If they can't reproduce locally, ask them to run a targeted curl loop so we can capture a failing request id live:
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://dedicated.redwood.example.com/v1/generate \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-test","input":"test","max_tokens":64}' -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null
  sleep 0.2
done
```
That will give a failure frequency and timestamps so we can correlate with node logs.

sre_bot: Incident tag `dedicated-inference-503` added to thread. Notify oncall when debug bundle uploaded.

alex.s: Once we have the files, please run our helper to collect a full debug bundle from the pod/node (this collects runtime logs, kernel logs, and GPU metrics) - example command (run on node that can access pods):
```bash
/opt/redwood/bin/collect-debug-bundle \
  --tenant acme-tenant-13 \
  --pod inference-runtime-0-5f7b9c8d-2xkq7 \
  --node gke-pool-ded-08 \
  --since "2026-04-12T09:30:00Z" \
  --out /tmp/acme-debug-1905000000.tar.gz
```
Then upload using internal helper: `rdupload /tmp/acme-debug-1905000000.tar.gz` and paste the resulting S3 URL here.

support_tina: Quick check of the small snippet they pasted earlier - I found one dmesg line they sent in chat: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:01:00): 31` at 2026-04-12T10:08:12Z. They also saw a runtime `OOM killer invoked` around 10:09Z in kubelet logs. Putting that together, might be GPU driver error then container instability.

maria_ryu: Yup that aligns. Ask them for nvidia-bug-report.log if possible; it contains driver repro data: `sudo nvidia-bug-report.sh --output-file /tmp/nbreport.tar.gz` (only if customer consents; it's large). Also collect `/var/log/messages` around the timestamps.

devon_ops: If debug bundle shows repeated Xid 31, escalate to drivers team and include node hardware id + kernel version. Also include the exact NVIDIA driver version from `nvidia-smi`.

support_tina: Got it. I'm running the kubectl and collect-debug now (I'll run from our bastion). Will upload to support bucket when done and paste link. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

alex.s: Thanks — once uploaded I'll run an initial triage and ping drivers if Xid repeated. If it's purely OOM, we can look at memory hold patterns and our batching parameters.

support_tina: Uploaded bundle: s3://redwood-support-debug/acme/acme-debug-1905000000.tar.gz
Files attached: /tmp/acme-pod-runtime.log, node-dmesg.log, nvidia-smi-1905000000.txt, node-kubelet.log.

devon_ops: Received. Kicking off triage. If anyone finds additional request_ids while we run analysis, paste them here so we can correlate with the bundle timestamps.

support_tina: Will do — forwarded customer's additional failing request ids: req_72aa12, req_72aa47.

sre_bot: Noted. Oncall alerted.

support_tina: Closing loop for now, will update after triage.
